# Pre-refactor compatibility fixture

`table.joblib` was generated before relocating the implementation, with the
original `predictml.tabular.application.TabularModel` and
`predictml.tabular.preprocessing.Preprocessor` class paths. It uses the bundled
synthetic housing.csv and housing-config.json, three epochs, validation interval
1, seed 42, default hidden layers (32, 16). `predictions.json` contains predictions
for every input row from baseline, linear and MLP before the refactor.

The trusted payload is deliberately not regenerated by tests: replacing it with
a model built by the new implementation would stop checking old class paths.
The binary was produced in the Python 3.12 CPU acceptance environment with the
pinned project requirements. The fixture verifies format and numerical behavior,
not forecasting quality.
